verdict.rationale: Reducto's Extract endpoint returns schema-defined structured JSON from tables, and dedicated table-output-format configs plus citations support clean, typed data ready for downstream loading (reducto-docs-2/19, reducto-docs-14, reducto-docs-11/22). However, independent community reports flag accuracy problems on longer/complex documents ('did struggle with long documents... 300+ pages', and a rival founder claiming other tools are 'better at just getting data out of PDFs accurately'), suggesting manual cleanup may still be needed in some cases. Missing for 10: independent benchmarking on table-heavy documents confirming zero manual cleanup, and resolution of the long-document accuracy complaints.
